lunch.name: Wiener Wurst mit Sauerkraut (Sausage with Sauerkraut)
lunch.description: German lunch classic - bratwurst with sauerkraut and potato salad. Represents German food culture
instructions: Heat oil, sauté sliced onion until golden
Add sauerkraut and caraway seeds, stir well
Simmer 20-30 minutes on low heat
Grill or pan-fry sausages until golden and cooked through
Serve sausages on dark bread with sauerkraut and German mustard on side
Accompany with warm potato salad
lunch.notes: Long simmering of sauerkraut develops flavor. Caraway seeds are traditional
lunch.fun_fact: Sausage with sauerkraut is German lunch classic, represents German food culture worldwide

dinner.name: German Sauerbraten (German Sour Pot Roast with Sweet-Tangy Gravy)
dinner.description: German sour pot roast with sweet-tangy gravy - German dinner tradition
ingredients: 1.5kg beef chuck roast, rump roast, or bottom round
instructions: Combine red wine, red wine vinegar, beef stock, onions, carrots, celery, garlic, bay leaves, peppercorns, juniper in container
Add beef roast; cover completely with marinade
Refrigerate 3-7 days, turning meat daily
Remove roast from marinade; reserve marinade; pat roast dry
Strain marinade, reserving vegetables and liquid separately
Heat oil in large heavy pot or Dutch oven over medium-high heat
Brown roast on all sides (10-12 minutes total); remove
Add reserved marinated vegetables to pot; sauté 5 minutes
Pour reserved marinade liquid over vegetables
Return beef to pot; liquid should come halfway up sides
Bring to boil; reduce heat to low, cover
Braise 2.5-3 hours until very tender, turning roast halfway
Remove roast; tent loosely with foil to keep warm
Strain braising liquid through fine sieve, discard vegetables
Return liquid to pot; bring to simmer over medium heat
Add sugar and crushed gingersnaps; stir until thickened
Taste and adjust salt/sugar/acid balance
Slice roast and serve with gravy, spaetzle noodles and braised red cabbage
dinner.notes: Marinating for up to week tenderizes meat through acid penetration
dinner.fun_fact: Traditional method marinates tough beef in vinegar for up to a week
